user.title: Velador
user.description: Velador watches every loaded integration and revives the ones that die silently (config entry loaded, entities unavailable). No configuration needed — tune sensitivity later in Options.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is possible.

data.min_entities: Minimum entities for an integration to be watched
data.strikes: Consecutive failed scans before declaring zombie
data.cooldown_hours: Hours between reload attempts of the same integration
data.grace_minutes: Grace minutes after Home Assistant starts
data.stale_minutes: Minutes without reporting to declare stale

zombie.title: Zombie integration: {title}
zombie.description: The integration **{title}** ({domain}) reports as loaded but {dead} of {total} of its entities are unavailable. Velador will try to reload it automatically.

incurable.title: Integration needs manual attention: {title}
incurable.description: The integration **{title}** ({domain}) stayed dead after {attempts} automatic reloads. It likely needs re-authentication, a credential fix or physical attention. Velador will stop reloading it until it recovers.

stale.title: Stale sensor: {entity_id}
stale.description: **{entity_id}** has not reported for {minutes} minutes and still shows {state} as if it were current. A frozen sensor's last value is a lie — check the device, its battery or its mesh.
